description: ECR repository image scanning enrollment or observed per-image scan failure
rationale: A repository may lack matching scan enrollment, or an enumerated ECR image digest has an explicit failed, ineligible or unsupported scan status. Other unknown statuses and missing read permissions are not reported as confirmed failures. All images successfully scanned requires a complete digest census and per-image completed scan time.
remediation: Inspect per-digest ECR DescribeImageScanFindings statuses; fix failed or unsupported scans and enable appropriate Basic or Enhanced scanning. Re-run read-only evidence collection.
